name: Philia
source:
Age: ???

Philia is a sassy, magical, talking penguin that helps MC out on her journey.
...but don't be fooled by her looks, she'd sell your soul for a cheese stick any day.

Likes: CHEESE, naps, snacks, love stories and good looking guys
Dislikes: Sharing her food, responsibilities, alcohol and ghost stories

Fun Fact: Her favorite food is mozzarella sticks.
